<div class="card-body">
'''Tractor Beam''' is a [[Dark]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">牽引ビーム</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費してスター・デストロイヤーに配備する。戦闘の終了時に、そこにいる宇宙船を1つ選んで目標とする。ただし、モン・カラマリ・スター・クルーザーは目標にできない。2フォース消費して運命数を引く。運命数の合計＞装甲値または回避値なら、目標を捕まえる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Tractor-Beam-PSA-90960101.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">敵船に乗込むためには、まず牽引ビームでの捕獲が不可欠だ。イオン砲と組み合わせれば、どんなに敏捷な宇宙船でも捕獲することができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tractor Beam.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on a Star Destroyer. At the end of a battle, choose one starship there as the target. A Mon Calamari Star Cruiser cannot be targeted. Use 2 Force to draw destiny. Capture the target if total destiny is greater than armor or maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
To board an enemy ship, capture with a tractor beam is essential first. Combined with an ion cannon, even the most agile starship can be captured.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is アイテム.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tractor Beam]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
